featured.story: I was rejected three times because of broken English and poor interview confidence. At Global Spoken English, Coach Faizan Khan personally identified my grammatical pitfalls and made me speak every single day in front of the entire class. By month 2, I aced Wipro's rigorous panel round.
featured.highlight: Placed at Wipro with 45% salary hike

featured.story: The framework taught for answering 'Tell Me About Yourself' and handling behavioral STAR questions was gold. In the interview, I felt 100% in control. The mock sessions made the real interview feel like just another practice day.

Teaching English literature is one thing; speaking with international phonetics and flawless cadence is another. Global Spoken English's voice culture training elevated my pedagogical confidence tremendously.
